description: Test suite for Vitest configuration and utility functions, including functions for resolving worker limits, scheduling, parsing process stats, and default configs.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Returns the default pool type for Vitest, which is 'threads'.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of local workers for Vitest based on environment, CPU, memory, and system load.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Determines workload scheduling parameters like maxWorkers, fileParallelism, and throttling based on current system state.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Parses running Vitest processes to count roots and workers, excluding a specified PID.
